description: Five separate underground full-scene concepts generated from user-authorized prompts. Exact tool PNGs are copied without resizing, editing, or altering existing game artwork/collisions. No authenticated Figma design extraction is claimed.

Level 01: Hollow Tree. The entire level is deep underground inside a vast cavern: absolutely NO outdoor sky, moon, clouds, distant mountains, skyline, or above-ground landscape. A massive bent ancient moss-covered hollow tree dominates the silhouette, with thick root and soil masses, an amber-lit entry door, a small scenic pond on the left, spacious open negative-space cavities inside the trunk, timber galleries, ladders formed of roots and wood, a lower root passage, and a quiet upper canopy chamber that still sits beneath the cave ceiling. Make the gameplay route intuitive: a broad dry left entry court, a clearly visible continuous main climb with broad stable landings rather than tiny stepping dots, one connected secondary return loop through the hollow interior, and a few quiet cache nooks that do not compete with the main route. Maintain generous headroom at the upper route. Meticulous dark mossy pixel art, hand-placed crisp square pixels, thick believable terrain masses, warm amber lanterns, weathered timber, subdued teal shadow depth, restrained flowers and fungi, legible playable surfaces. Include just one tiny gardener explorer, about 24 native pixels tall and approximately 3 percent of image height, standing at the entry for scale. Entire level fits in the image with room around all edges and no cropped architecture. Flat 2D orthographic side-view game art, no perspective or isometric view. No UI, no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no panel grid, no contact sheet, no title. Design reference artwork only.
